title: HackerEarth: Monk and Welcome Problem
description: Given two integer arrays `a` and `b` of identical length, return a new array where each element is the sum of corresponding elements of `a` and `b`.
constraints:
1 <= len(a) == len(b) <= 10^5
• Time: O(N) | Space: O(N)
starter_code:
def add_arrays(a: list[int], b: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    pass
solution:
def add_arrays(a: list[int], b: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    return [x + y for x, y in zip(a, b)]
explanation: Zips arrays and adds element-wise in O(N) time.
